note: Five curated resources are live-no-op-write-verified and 33 more are live-read-verified, against Orchestrator 9.7.0.43282 / ECOS 9.7.0.0_109184 (2026-08-30). Level 4 means current state was staged back through `load` and produced an empty diff — the resource does not manufacture phantom drift — and that `commit` then wrote nothing. It does NOT mean the write path works: an empty plan writes nothing, so no write path in this repository has been executed and verified on real gear. Level 5 is the floor for calling one supported and nothing has reached it. A programmatic equivalent of the level-4 check passed for 33 write-capable kinds with zero phantom drift, but only the five that were run through the documented CLI procedure are promoted; the rest are recorded as supporting evidence in docs/sitrep/2026-08-30-live-read.md. Three kinds stay at mock-verified because nothing of that kind is configured on the observed fabric. docs/live-validation.md is the protocol for level 5.
